description:
Delivery culture existed even during the Japanese colonial era. But… you want me to deliver this? The year is 1931, Gyeongseong (colonial-era Seoul). Tae-seong is a veteran delivery man for a popular cold noodle restaurant. One ordinary day, he discovers a secret letter hidden inside one of the bowls — and his peaceful, uneventful life is turned completely upside down. Dangerous requests. Police on his tail. And emotions stirring deep within him that he can’t quite suppress. For a man who wanted absolutely nothing to do with the independence movement, the most nerve-wracking delivery of his life has just begun.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=850967), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14216207)
